items_flat.title_en: Anthropic amended S-1 reveals ~$17B Q3 revenue and $895B compute commitments
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic修正S-1揭露第三季約170億美元營收與8950億美元運算承諾
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed an amended Form S-1/A on November 2 disclosing Q3 2026 revenue of $16.96 billion (up 1,127% year-over-year and 47% quarter-over-quarter). It swung to a $567 million operating loss, mainly from higher-cost short-term compute, while total compute purchase commitments and leases reached about $895 billion.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日提交修正版Form S-1/A，揭露2026年第三季營收169.6億美元（年增1,127%、季增47%）。公司轉為5.67億美元營運虧損，主要因較高成本的短期運算，而運算採購承諾與租賃總額約達8950億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The filing quantifies the capital intensity of frontier AI scaling and shows sequential growth already decelerating while absolute compute obligations remain enormous. IPO investors will weigh the growth trajectory against these multi-hundred-billion-dollar commitments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文件量化了前沿AI擴張的資本密集程度，顯示季成長已開始放緩，但絕對運算義務仍極為龐大。IPO投資人將權衡成長軌跡與這些數千億美元的承諾。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shows ChatGPT and Codex accelerating physical engineering and hardware design
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI展示ChatGPT與Codex加速實體工程與硬體設計
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a research post on November 3 describing how ChatGPT and Codex help engineers with CAD, PCB design, simulation, and manufacturing drawings. Internal hardware team token use grew 23-fold since February; a side project used GPT-6 Astra to design a Codex device prototype in under a week, with industry work alongside Chip Ganassi Racing and Mazda.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月3日發布研究文章，說明ChatGPT與Codex如何協助工程師進行CAD、PCB設計、模擬與製造圖。內部硬體團隊自二月以來的token使用量成長23倍；一項附帶專案使用GPT-6 Astra在一週內設計出Codex裝置原型，並與Chip Ganassi Racing及Mazda合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending agentic coding tools into hardware shortens digital iteration but does not remove physical constraints such as tolerances, compliance, or manufacturing. Early internal gains highlight the gap between simulation scores and real-world fabrication readiness.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將代理編碼工具延伸至硬體可縮短數位迭代，但無法消除公差、合規或製造等實體限制。早期內部進展凸顯模擬分數與真實製造準備度之間的落差。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享OpenAI模型如何協助工程師設計、模擬與建造實體產品的進展。

items_flat.title_en: Google releases Physical-Engineering’s Last Exam (PLE) agent benchmark and open competition
items_flat.title_zh: Google發布實體工程最終考試（PLE）代理基準與公開競賽
items_flat.summary_en: On November 3 Google AI & Infrastructure announced PLE, an 85-task benchmark of long-horizon mechanical, electrical, civil and structural engineering work developed with Mercor. It released 29 public tasks, graders and a leaderboard; on the private set even top models fall short of full code-compliant, cost-aware designs.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月3日，Google AI與基礎設施團隊與Mercor合作宣布PLE，這是一項包含85項長期機械、電機、土木與結構工程任務的基準。它釋出29項公開任務、評分器與排行榜；在私有集上，即使頂尖模型也未能產出完全符合規範且具成本意識的設計。
items_flat.analysis_en: PLE exposes a clear gap between strong coding-agent scores and the ability to produce fully code-compliant, cost-aware physical designs. Hard safety gates mean partial correctness still fails the exam.
items_flat.analysis_zh: PLE揭示了強大編碼代理分數與產出完全符合規範、具成本意識的實體設計能力之間的明顯落差。嚴格的安全門檻意味著部分正確仍無法通過考試。
items_flat.quote: Today, the Google AI & Infrastructure team is announcing Physical-Engineering's Last Exam (PLE), a new benchmark and open competition.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Google AI與基礎設施團隊宣布實體工程最終考試（PLE），一項新的基準與公開競賽。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for cryptographic proof of LLM inference
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開源FlashProve以提供LLM推論的密碼學證明
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team published on November 2 and highlighted on X on November 3 FlashProve, an open-source zkSNARK prototype that lets a provider commit to model weights and prove a response came from that model without revealing them. On a 400B MoE (Llama 4 Maverick) it generates proofs at ~110 tokens/s on one H100, at 70–95× the GPU time of vLLM.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊於11月2日發布並於11月3日在X上強調FlashProve，這是一個開源zkSNARK原型，讓供應商承諾模型權重並證明回應來自該模型而不揭露權重。在400B MoE（Llama 4 Maverick）上，單一H100可達約110 tokens/s，為vLLM GPU時間的70–95倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: Provable inference addresses real trust gaps in routing, evaluation and server compromise, but the 70–95× proving overhead versus vLLM keeps it a research prototype rather than a production path for frontier models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可證明推論解決了路由、評估與伺服器遭入侵等真實信任落差，但相較vLLM的70–95倍證明開銷，使其仍為研究原型而非前沿模型的生產路徑。
items_flat.quote: Today we are releasing five artifacts: ... FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們釋出五項成果：……FlashProve：一個用於可證明推論的開源高效原型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces Pando, a Git-compatible backend scaled for Codex-driven monorepo work
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Pando，為Codex驅動的單一儲存庫工作擴展的Git相容後端
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published an engineering post on November 2 describing Pando, a new Git-compatible backend that now powers its monorepo. Built in roughly 10 weeks with heavy Codex agent assistance, it supports concurrent pushes across branches, reusable objects, and high-scale agent workloads.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日發布工程文章，描述Pando，這是一個現已驅動其單一儲存庫的新Git相容後端。在約10週內以大量Codex代理協助建置，支援跨分支並發推送、可重用物件與高規模代理工作負載。
items_flat.analysis_en: Agentic coding has shifted the bottleneck from model capability to surrounding infrastructure such as source control. Pando shows one lab treating that infrastructure as first-class product work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 代理編碼已將瓶頸從模型能力轉移到原始碼控制等周邊基礎設施。Pando顯示一家實驗室將該基礎設施視為一流產品工作。
items_flat.quote: We built Pando, a new backend for Git repositories, without interrupting any engineering work or changing how our team uses Git. Pando now powers all development in OpenAI’s monorepo.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們打造了 Pando，一個新的 Git 儲存庫後端，過程中未中斷任何工程工作，也未改變團隊使用 Git 的方式。Pando 現在驅動 OpenAI monorepo 的所有開發。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1T-parameter Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral釋出1T參數Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a roughly 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model, on October 29 under a modified MIT-style license. After additional reinforcement learning it leads open models on coding-agent indices while using fewer tokens than GLM-5.3.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral於10月29日釋出其改進版Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的開源權重，這是一款約1兆參數的原生多模態混合專家模型，採用修改版MIT風格授權。經過額外強化學習後，它在編碼代理指數上領先開源模型，同時比GLM-5.3使用更少token。
items_flat.analysis_en: A European lab shipping a trillion-parameter open-weight model with strong coding and cyber results lowers the barrier for sovereign or on-premise frontier-class agents. Token efficiency claims remain dependent on independent verification.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 一家歐洲實驗室釋出擁有強大編碼與網路安全結果的兆參數開源權重模型，降低了主權或本地部署前沿級代理的門檻。token效率主張仍取決於獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind adds Cheminformatics Skills to Antigravity for drug discovery workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind為Antigravity新增化學資訊技能以加速藥物發現工作流程
items_flat.summary_en: On November 3 Google DeepMind published a post showing Google Antigravity equipped with new Cheminformatics Skills that search literature, perform matched molecular pair analysis, build potency models, and propose rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes for lung-cancer targets in about an hour. The skills are available now; 10,000 scientists can apply for free high-tier access.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月3日，Google DeepMind發布文章，展示搭載新化學資訊技能的Google Antigravity能搜尋文獻、進行匹配分子對分析、建立效力模型，並在約一小時內為肺癌標靶提出剛化大環與合成路徑。技能現已可用；1萬名科學家可申請免費高階使用權。
items_flat.analysis_en: Domain-specific skills grounded in RDKit and public databases turn general agents into practical science workbenches, but sparse assay data and the need for experimental validation still limit how far computational proposals can go.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 以RDKit與公開資料庫為基礎的領域特定技能，將通用代理轉變為實用的科學工作台，但稀疏的測定資料與實驗驗證需求仍限制計算提案能走多遠。
items_flat.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這裡我們展示搭載新化學資訊技能的Google Antigravity如何加速藥物發現工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI任命Jill Hazelbaker為首席企業事務官
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 3 that Jill Hazelbaker, formerly President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer at Uber, will join as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer reporting to Greg Brockman. She will lead global communications, corporate positioning, brand, and public trust efforts.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月3日宣布，前Uber總裁兼首席企業事務官Jill Hazelbaker將加入擔任首席企業事務官，向Greg Brockman報告。她將領導全球傳播、企業定位、品牌與公眾信任工作。
items_flat.analysis_en: Filling a role vacant for roughly ten months signals OpenAI’s focus on external narrative and regulatory engagement as it scales infrastructure and approaches potential public markets. Impact depends on how the function is resourced relative to product and policy teams.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 填補約十個月空缺的職位，顯示OpenAI在擴張基礎設施並接近潛在公開市場時，更注重外部敘事與監管互動。影響取決於該職能相對於產品與政策團隊的資源配置。
items_flat.quote: As AI becomes part of more people’s lives, how we communicate, engage, and earn public trust has never been more important.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著AI成為更多人生活的一部分，我們如何溝通、互動並贏得公眾信任從未如此重要。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program for flexible demand response at compute campuses
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Grid Protectors計畫，讓運算園區提供彈性需求回應
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 2 the Grid Protectors Program, under which future compute campuses will reduce electricity demand when local grids are strained. The pilot is the planned Effingham County, Georgia campus, which has committed up to 1,000 MW of flexible demand response under its Georgia Power agreement.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日宣布Grid Protectors計畫，未來運算園區將在當地電網緊張時降低用電需求。試點是計畫中的喬治亞州Effingham縣園區，已根據與Georgia Power的協議承諾最高1,000 MW的彈性需求回應。
items_flat.analysis_en: Demand-response commitments address community and regulatory concerns about AI load, yet flexibility cannot substitute for new generation and transmission. The Georgia numbers show one early model; broader adoption depends on utility agreements that have not yet been finalized elsewhere.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 需求回應承諾回應了社區與監管對AI負載的擔憂，但彈性無法取代新發電與輸電。喬治亞數字展示了一個早期模式；更廣泛採用取決於其他地方尚未敲定的公用事業協議。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re launching the Grid Protectors Program, a national effort to support affordable, reliable electricity for families and businesses in the communities where we build.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Grid Protectors計畫，這是一項全國性努力，旨在支持我們建設所在社區的家庭與企業獲得可負擔、可靠的電力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes LifeVal, an evaluation of everyday personal-assistant tasks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布LifeVal，評估日常個人助理任務
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released LifeVal on November 2, a benchmark of practical everyday tasks (childcare, health, household administration, finances, shopping, government services) shaped by time-use studies and a survey of nearly 4,000 people. On OpenAI’s internal scoring, current models still leave substantial headroom.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日釋出LifeVal，這是一項涵蓋育兒、健康、家庭行政、財務、購物與政府服務等實用日常任務的基準，由時間使用研究與近4,000人調查塑造。根據OpenAI內部評分，現行模型仍有大量進步空間。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving evaluation beyond coding and exams toward multi-step real-world errands is directionally useful for personal agents, but the benchmark is internal and self-scored, so independent replication remains needed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將評估從編碼與考試轉向多步驟真實世界事務，對個人代理具方向性價值，但基準為內部自評，仍需獨立複製。
items_flat.quote: For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal...
items_flat.quote_zh: 為了讓 AGI 惠及全人類，它應幫助人們處理最重要的日常任務。因此我們打造了 LifeVal……

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands invisible text watermark to Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic將隱形文字浮水印擴展至Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6
items_flat.summary_en: Effective November 3, text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s invisible text watermark (an imperceptible pattern in word choice). On Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 the mark applies only at default sampling settings.
items_flat.summary_zh: 自11月3日起，由Claude Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6生成的文字帶有Anthropic的隱形文字浮水印（詞彙選擇中的不可察覺模式）。在Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6上，該標記僅在預設取樣設定下適用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The expansion advances EU AI Act Article 50 compliance, yet the default-parameter restriction on two widely used models creates a practical bypass that weakens the guarantee for many deployments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此擴展推進了歐盟AI法Article 50合規，但兩個廣泛使用模型的預設參數限制創造了實務繞過途徑，削弱了許多部署的保證。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for paid Residency aimed at senior technical leaders
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開放針對資深技術領導者的付費駐留計畫申請
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 2 that applications are open for its paid Residency (placements of six weeks to six months). The program targets professors in quantitative fields, technical founders, and staff-level engineers; no machine learning background is required.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日宣布其付費駐留計畫（六週至六個月）開放申請。該計畫針對量化領域教授、技術創辦人與資深工程師；不要求機器學習背景。
items_flat.analysis_en: Recruiting established quantitative talent without requiring prior ML experience is a practical response to the scarcity of experienced AI safety researchers. Success depends on how the placements convert into lasting research or product contributions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在不要求先前ML經驗的情況下招募既有量化人才，是對經驗豐富的AI安全研究人員短缺的實務回應。成功取決於這些駐留如何轉化為持久的研究或產品貢獻。
items_flat.quote: Today we are opening applications for the Anthropic Residency, our paid, fixed-term research program with placements lasting between six weeks and six months.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們開放 Anthropic Residency 申請，這是一個付費、固定期限的研究計畫，時長介於六週至六個月。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI raises bug bounty rewards (up to $172k) and plans next internal security sprint
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI提高漏洞賞金（最高17.2萬美元）並計畫下一次內部安全衝刺
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 2 that it is more than quadrupling average midpoints for medium/high/critical bug bounty rewards, with exceptional critical findings eligible for up to $172,000 including bonuses, and that past-30-day awards can be increased. It also outlined the next internal AI-assisted security sprint.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日宣布將中/高/嚴重漏洞賞金的平均中位數提高超過四倍，特殊嚴重發現最高可獲17.2萬美元（含獎金），且過去30天獎勵可調高。它也概述了下一次內部AI輔助安全衝刺。
items_flat.analysis_en: Higher external incentives plus internal AI-assisted red-teaming reflect growing recognition that model capabilities are outpacing traditional defenses. The real test is whether the higher payouts and sprints produce durable reductions in high-severity findings.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更高的外部誘因加上內部AI輔助紅隊，反映了模型能力超越傳統防禦的日益認知。真正考驗在於更高的給付與衝刺是否能持久降低高嚴重性發現。
items_flat.quote: As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do.
items_flat.quote_zh: 隨著 AI 在尋找漏洞方面變得更強，防禦方需要在攻擊者之前加以運用。

openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 3 that Jill Hazelbaker, formerly President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer at Uber, will join as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer reporting to Greg Brockman. She will lead global communications, corporate positioning, brand, and public trust efforts.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月3日宣布，前Uber總裁兼首席企業事務官Jill Hazelbaker將加入擔任首席企業事務官，向Greg Brockman報告。她將領導全球傳播、企業定位、品牌與公眾信任工作。
openai.analysis_en: Filling a role vacant for roughly ten months signals OpenAI’s focus on external narrative and regulatory engagement as it scales infrastructure and approaches potential public markets. Impact depends on how the function is resourced relative to product and policy teams.
openai.analysis_zh: 填補約十個月空缺的職位，顯示OpenAI在擴張基礎設施並接近潛在公開市場時，更注重外部敘事與監管互動。影響取決於該職能相對於產品與政策團隊的資源配置。
openai.quote: As AI becomes part of more people’s lives, how we communicate, engage, and earn public trust has never been more important.
openai.quote_zh: 隨著AI成為更多人生活的一部分，我們如何溝通、互動並贏得公眾信任從未如此重要。

openai.title_en: OpenAI launches Grid Protectors Program for flexible demand response at compute campuses
openai.title_zh: OpenAI推出Grid Protectors計畫，讓運算園區提供彈性需求回應
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 2 the Grid Protectors Program, under which future compute campuses will reduce electricity demand when local grids are strained. The pilot is the planned Effingham County, Georgia campus, which has committed up to 1,000 MW of flexible demand response under its Georgia Power agreement.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日宣布Grid Protectors計畫，未來運算園區將在當地電網緊張時降低用電需求。試點是計畫中的喬治亞州Effingham縣園區，已根據與Georgia Power的協議承諾最高1,000 MW的彈性需求回應。
openai.analysis_en: Demand-response commitments address community and regulatory concerns about AI load, yet flexibility cannot substitute for new generation and transmission. The Georgia numbers show one early model; broader adoption depends on utility agreements that have not yet been finalized elsewhere.
openai.analysis_zh: 需求回應承諾回應了社區與監管對AI負載的擔憂，但彈性無法取代新發電與輸電。喬治亞數字展示了一個早期模式；更廣泛採用取決於其他地方尚未敲定的公用事業協議。
openai.quote: Today we’re launching the Grid Protectors Program, a national effort to support affordable, reliable electricity for families and businesses in the communities where we build.
openai.quote_zh: 今天我們推出Grid Protectors計畫，這是一項全國性努力，旨在支持我們建設所在社區的家庭與企業獲得可負擔、可靠的電力。

openai.title_en: OpenAI publishes LifeVal, an evaluation of everyday personal-assistant tasks
openai.title_zh: OpenAI發布LifeVal，評估日常個人助理任務
openai.summary_en: OpenAI released LifeVal on November 2, a benchmark of practical everyday tasks (childcare, health, household administration, finances, shopping, government services) shaped by time-use studies and a survey of nearly 4,000 people. On OpenAI’s internal scoring, current models still leave substantial headroom.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日釋出LifeVal，這是一項涵蓋育兒、健康、家庭行政、財務、購物與政府服務等實用日常任務的基準，由時間使用研究與近4,000人調查塑造。根據OpenAI內部評分，現行模型仍有大量進步空間。
openai.analysis_en: Moving evaluation beyond coding and exams toward multi-step real-world errands is directionally useful for personal agents, but the benchmark is internal and self-scored, so independent replication remains needed.
openai.analysis_zh: 將評估從編碼與考試轉向多步驟真實世界事務，對個人代理具方向性價值，但基準為內部自評，仍需獨立複製。
openai.quote: For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal...
openai.quote_zh: 為了讓 AGI 惠及全人類，它應幫助人們處理最重要的日常任務。因此我們打造了 LifeVal……

openai.title_en: OpenAI raises bug bounty rewards (up to $172k) and plans next internal security sprint
openai.title_zh: OpenAI提高漏洞賞金（最高17.2萬美元）並計畫下一次內部安全衝刺
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 2 that it is more than quadrupling average midpoints for medium/high/critical bug bounty rewards, with exceptional critical findings eligible for up to $172,000 including bonuses, and that past-30-day awards can be increased. It also outlined the next internal AI-assisted security sprint.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月2日宣布將中/高/嚴重漏洞賞金的平均中位數提高超過四倍，特殊嚴重發現最高可獲17.2萬美元（含獎金），且過去30天獎勵可調高。它也概述了下一次內部AI輔助安全衝刺。
openai.analysis_en: Higher external incentives plus internal AI-assisted red-teaming reflect growing recognition that model capabilities are outpacing traditional defenses. The real test is whether the higher payouts and sprints produce durable reductions in high-severity findings.
openai.analysis_zh: 更高的外部誘因加上內部AI輔助紅隊，反映了模型能力超越傳統防禦的日益認知。真正考驗在於更高的給付與衝刺是否能持久降低高嚴重性發現。
openai.quote: As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do.
openai.quote_zh: 隨著 AI 在尋找漏洞方面變得更強，防禦方需要在攻擊者之前加以運用。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic amended S-1 reveals ~$17B Q3 revenue and $895B compute commitments
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic修正S-1揭露第三季約170億美元營收與8950億美元運算承諾
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic filed an amended Form S-1/A on November 2 disclosing Q3 2026 revenue of $16.96 billion (up 1,127% year-over-year and 47% quarter-over-quarter). It swung to a $567 million operating loss, mainly from higher-cost short-term compute, while total compute purchase commitments and leases reached about $895 billion.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日提交修正版Form S-1/A，揭露2026年第三季營收169.6億美元（年增1,127%、季增47%）。公司轉為5.67億美元營運虧損，主要因較高成本的短期運算，而運算採購承諾與租賃總額約達8950億美元。
anthropic.analysis_en: The filing quantifies the capital intensity of frontier AI scaling and shows sequential growth already decelerating while absolute compute obligations remain enormous. IPO investors will weigh the growth trajectory against these multi-hundred-billion-dollar commitments.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此文件量化了前沿AI擴張的資本密集程度，顯示季成長已開始放緩，但絕對運算義務仍極為龐大。IPO投資人將權衡成長軌跡與這些數千億美元的承諾。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for cryptographic proof of LLM inference
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開源FlashProve以提供LLM推論的密碼學證明
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team published on November 2 and highlighted on X on November 3 FlashProve, an open-source zkSNARK prototype that lets a provider commit to model weights and prove a response came from that model without revealing them. On a 400B MoE (Llama 4 Maverick) it generates proofs at ~110 tokens/s on one H100, at 70–95× the GPU time of vLLM.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic前沿紅隊於11月2日發布並於11月3日在X上強調FlashProve，這是一個開源zkSNARK原型，讓供應商承諾模型權重並證明回應來自該模型而不揭露權重。在400B MoE（Llama 4 Maverick）上，單一H100可達約110 tokens/s，為vLLM GPU時間的70–95倍。
anthropic.analysis_en: Provable inference addresses real trust gaps in routing, evaluation and server compromise, but the 70–95× proving overhead versus vLLM keeps it a research prototype rather than a production path for frontier models.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 可證明推論解決了路由、評估與伺服器遭入侵等真實信任落差，但相較vLLM的70–95倍證明開銷，使其仍為研究原型而非前沿模型的生產路徑。
anthropic.quote: Today we are releasing five artifacts: ... FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天我們釋出五項成果：……FlashProve：一個用於可證明推論的開源高效原型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands invisible text watermark to Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic將隱形文字浮水印擴展至Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6
anthropic.summary_en: Effective November 3, text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s invisible text watermark (an imperceptible pattern in word choice). On Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 the mark applies only at default sampling settings.
anthropic.summary_zh: 自11月3日起，由Claude Mythos 5、Opus 4.7、Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6生成的文字帶有Anthropic的隱形文字浮水印（詞彙選擇中的不可察覺模式）。在Opus 4.6與Sonnet 4.6上，該標記僅在預設取樣設定下適用。
anthropic.analysis_en: The expansion advances EU AI Act Article 50 compliance, yet the default-parameter restriction on two widely used models creates a practical bypass that weakens the guarantee for many deployments.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此擴展推進了歐盟AI法Article 50合規，但兩個廣泛使用模型的預設參數限制創造了實務繞過途徑，削弱了許多部署的保證。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens applications for paid Residency aimed at senior technical leaders
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開放針對資深技術領導者的付費駐留計畫申請
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic announced on November 2 that applications are open for its paid Residency (placements of six weeks to six months). The program targets professors in quantitative fields, technical founders, and staff-level engineers; no machine learning background is required.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月2日宣布其付費駐留計畫（六週至六個月）開放申請。該計畫針對量化領域教授、技術創辦人與資深工程師；不要求機器學習背景。
anthropic.analysis_en: Recruiting established quantitative talent without requiring prior ML experience is a practical response to the scarcity of experienced AI safety researchers. Success depends on how the placements convert into lasting research or product contributions.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 在不要求先前ML經驗的情況下招募既有量化人才，是對經驗豐富的AI安全研究人員短缺的實務回應。成功取決於這些駐留如何轉化為持久的研究或產品貢獻。
anthropic.quote: Today we are opening applications for the Anthropic Residency, our paid, fixed-term research program with placements lasting between six weeks and six months.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天我們開放 Anthropic Residency 申請，這是一個付費、固定期限的研究計畫，時長介於六週至六個月。

google.title_en: Google releases Physical-Engineering’s Last Exam (PLE) agent benchmark and open competition
google.title_zh: Google發布實體工程最終考試（PLE）代理基準與公開競賽
google.summary_en: On November 3 Google AI & Infrastructure announced PLE, an 85-task benchmark of long-horizon mechanical, electrical, civil and structural engineering work developed with Mercor. It released 29 public tasks, graders and a leaderboard; on the private set even top models fall short of full code-compliant, cost-aware designs.
google.summary_zh: 11月3日，Google AI與基礎設施團隊與Mercor合作宣布PLE，這是一項包含85項長期機械、電機、土木與結構工程任務的基準。它釋出29項公開任務、評分器與排行榜；在私有集上，即使頂尖模型也未能產出完全符合規範且具成本意識的設計。
google.analysis_en: PLE exposes a clear gap between strong coding-agent scores and the ability to produce fully code-compliant, cost-aware physical designs. Hard safety gates mean partial correctness still fails the exam.
google.analysis_zh: PLE揭示了強大編碼代理分數與產出完全符合規範、具成本意識的實體設計能力之間的明顯落差。嚴格的安全門檻意味著部分正確仍無法通過考試。
google.quote: Today, the Google AI & Infrastructure team is announcing Physical-Engineering's Last Exam (PLE), a new benchmark and open competition.
google.quote_zh: 今天，Google AI與基礎設施團隊宣布實體工程最終考試（PLE），一項新的基準與公開競賽。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind adds Cheminformatics Skills to Antigravity for drug discovery workflows
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind為Antigravity新增化學資訊技能以加速藥物發現工作流程
google.summary_en: On November 3 Google DeepMind published a post showing Google Antigravity equipped with new Cheminformatics Skills that search literature, perform matched molecular pair analysis, build potency models, and propose rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes for lung-cancer targets in about an hour. The skills are available now; 10,000 scientists can apply for free high-tier access.
google.summary_zh: 11月3日，Google DeepMind發布文章，展示搭載新化學資訊技能的Google Antigravity能搜尋文獻、進行匹配分子對分析、建立效力模型，並在約一小時內為肺癌標靶提出剛化大環與合成路徑。技能現已可用；1萬名科學家可申請免費高階使用權。
google.analysis_en: Domain-specific skills grounded in RDKit and public databases turn general agents into practical science workbenches, but sparse assay data and the need for experimental validation still limit how far computational proposals can go.
google.analysis_zh: 以RDKit與公開資料庫為基礎的領域特定技能，將通用代理轉變為實用的科學工作台，但稀疏的測定資料與實驗驗證需求仍限制計算提案能走多遠。
google.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.
google.quote_zh: 這裡我們展示搭載新化學資訊技能的Google Antigravity如何加速藥物發現工作流程。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1T-parameter Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk)
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral釋出1T參數Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的開源權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of its improved Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a roughly 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model, on October 29 under a modified MIT-style license. After additional reinforcement learning it leads open models on coding-agent indices while using fewer tokens than GLM-5.3.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral於10月29日釋出其改進版Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的開源權重，這是一款約1兆參數的原生多模態混合專家模型，採用修改版MIT風格授權。經過額外強化學習後，它在編碼代理指數上領先開源模型，同時比GLM-5.3使用更少token。
frontier_other.analysis_en: A European lab shipping a trillion-parameter open-weight model with strong coding and cyber results lowers the barrier for sovereign or on-premise frontier-class agents. Token efficiency claims remain dependent on independent verification.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 一家歐洲實驗室釋出擁有強大編碼與網路安全結果的兆參數開源權重模型，降低了主權或本地部署前沿級代理的門檻。token效率主張仍取決於獨立驗證。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we're releasing the weights of this improved Mistral Large 4.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出這個改進版 Mistral Large 4 的權重。

brief_en: Anthropic’s amended S-1 shows ~$17B Q3 revenue and massive compute commitments. OpenAI advances physical engineering with ChatGPT/Codex, hires a corporate affairs chief, and launches Grid Protectors for demand response. Google DeepMind ships an engineering benchmark and cheminformatics skills; Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference.
brief_zh: Anthropic修正S-1揭露第三季約170億美元營收與龐大運算承諾。OpenAI以ChatGPT/Codex推進實體工程、任命企業事務主管並推出電網保護計畫。Google DeepMind發布工程基準與化學資訊技能；Anthropic開源FlashProve以實現可證明推論。
